definitions.full: H4042. magan מָגַן verb only Pi`el deliver up, deliver (denominative from מָגֵן ; on connection of meanings compare סָגַר ) — Perfect מִגֵּן Gen 14:20 ; Imperfect 3feminine singular suffix תְּמַגְּנֶ֑ךָּ Prov 4:9 אֲמַגֶּנְךָ Hosea 11:8 ; — deliver up to adversary Gen 14:20 ; Hosea 11:8 + Isa 64:6 ᵑ7 ᵑ6 ᵐ5 Ew Che and others וַתְּמַגְּנֵּנוּ for וַתְּמגֵנוּ ᵑ0 ; also deliver, give , with accusative & suffix of indirect object Prov 4:9 .
